title: I Dated a Robot!
description: Ordinary human dating. It’s enjoyable and it serves an important purpose. But when a human dates an artificial mate, there is no purpose, only enjoyment. And that leads to tragedy.
quote: They’re trapped! Trapped in a soft, vice-like grip of robot lips.
altHero: man in a suit speaking to the camera as a young man makes out with a Marilyn Monroe robot on a bed
alt1: young man excited, sitting in a cafe booth, in front of him is a computer and a Marilyn Monroe robot
alt2: man making out with Marilyn Monroe robot while his parents and ex-girlfriend look worried
alt3: split screen of a man making out with a woman robot and an old woman making out with a man robot
alt4: man kissing robot while the word “Technology” crumbles
